name: @wewin/dashboard
//port: 3001, because apps/api owns 3000 and the two run side by side all day. It is written into the scripts rather than left to Next's default so that `pnpm dev` at the root never has to be told twice.
//lint: oxlint reads the root .oxlintrc.json, same as every other package. There is no `next lint`: a second linter with a second rule set is a second opinion about the same code.
//contract: @wewin/contract is here for the product screens rather than for the shell, which imports nothing from it yet. It is the package that puts a unit on every exact quantity — `{"unit":"um","digits":"3200000"}` and not a bare number — and adding it later would mean a lockfile change in the middle of somebody else's work.
//core: @wewin/core is here for one reason: the catalogue is authored in centimetres and held in micrometres, and `@wewin/core/units` + `@wewin/core/format` are where that conversion already lives. A screen that reimplemented `fromMicrons` would be a second answer to a question the domain has already answered, and the two would disagree the first time a rounding rule changed. Type-only imports would not need this entry — these are runtime calls, from the browser, through the subpath exports.
//radix: Only the unified `radix-ui` package, which is what shadcn's generated components import. `shadcn` itself is a dependency and not a devDependency because globals.css does `@import "shadcn/tailwind.css"` — the CSS pipeline resolves it at build time.
